sentences.text: Eleven days after he resigned, Jensen Huang is back in charge of Nvidia.
On Monday, the board voted unanimously to reinstate him as president and CEO.
He had stepped down after admitting an affair with a woman U.S. officials suspect of spying for China.
The board says input from senior U.S. officials convinced it that his return poses no national security risk.
President Trump had pushed for his return, and called it the correct and proper decision.
Nvidia shares opened about 30 percent higher.
Board chair Harvey Jones stays on, and Colette Kress remains chief financial officer.
The board's own investigation continues, and Huang still faces questions from Congress.
